description: Retrieve CAPEC attack patterns, categories, and views by ID, such as CAPEC-66, CAPEC66, or 66, including Deprecated and Obsolete records; each entry’s type says which. Processes up to 20 distinct IDs within a 24,000-byte response budget and discloses deferred IDs; a CWE ID or an item that is no ID returns in notFound with recovery guidance; only an item holding a control character other than whitespace, or a non-ID item over 150 characters, rejects the whole call. Patterns default to summary, prerequisites, execution, mitigations, and mappings; categories and views default to summary (the category summary or view objective) and relations (members in source order, or a filter-defined view’s source XPath filterDefinition). Views CAPEC-1000 (Mechanisms of Attack) and CAPEC-3000 (Domains of Attack) are entry points for browsing patterns by category. A default section that does not fit the budget is omitted whole and named with its size and a re-call (kind partial). The notes section, outside the defaults, returns recorded MITRE notes. Explicit sections remain complete, including one oversized record with disclosure; an empty array requests an outline. Recorded CWE and ATT&CK mappings are incomplete and do not establish current ATT&CK validation.

ids.description: One to 200 submitted IDs; up to 20 distinct items are processed within the response budget.

items.description: A CAPEC ID such as CAPEC-66 or a positive bare integer. An item that is no CAPEC ID is reported per item; an item holding a control character other than whitespace, or over 150 characters and no CWE or CAPEC ID, rejects the call.

sections.description: Selected sections; omit for defaults, or pass an empty array for an outline.

name: cwe_get_attack_pattern

deferredIds.description: Distinct items to submit in a later call: canonical IDs, or the collapsed text of an item that is no ID.

items.description: Distinct items to submit in a later call: canonical IDs, or the collapsed text of an item that is no ID.

entries.description: Found projected entries in request order.

items.description: Projected CAPEC attack pattern, category, or view.

alternateTerms.description: Alternate terms MITRE records for this entry, in source order; absent when none are recorded.

description.description: Source explanation of the term in CommonMark.

attackTechniqueIds.description: Recorded ATT&CK IDs; not a current validation.

items.description: Recorded ATT&CK IDs; not a current validation.

availableSections.description: Sections actually present in the catalog entry.

items.description: Sections actually present in the catalog entry.

description.description: Complete source description in CommonMark: a pattern description, category summary, or view objective.

executionFlow.description: Complete execution flow in source order.

filterDefinition.description: Source XPath filter defining a filter-defined view’s membership, exactly as published.

kind.description: full: every selected section the entry has, complete. partial: the sections of a default selection that fit the 24,000-byte response budget, complete, with the omitted ones in outline. outline: identity and section sizes only.

members.description: Direct members of a category or view in source order.

abstraction.description: Source abstraction of a member attack pattern.

notes.description: Notes MITRE records for this entry, in source order; absent when none are recorded.

type.description: Source note type such as Relationship, Maintenance, Terminology, or Research Gap.

outline.description: Sections available but not included in this entry, with sizes: every available section of an outline, or the selected sections a partial entry omitted.

items.description: Section not included in this entry, and its size.

sizeInBytes.description: Delivered UTF-8 size of the section on both surfaces: its structuredContent JSON plus its rendered content[] text.

type.description: CAPEC record type: an attack pattern, or a category or view that organizes patterns.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Call-level guidance: deferred-ID continuation, budget disclosure, and the re-call for parameters the selected sections leave unused.

notFound.description: Per-ID misses; an all-missing batch is success.

id.description: Canonical requested ID, or for invalid_id the submitted item trimmed, with whitespace runs collapsed to one space.

reason.description: Missing record, record of another family or type, or an item that is no catalog ID.

totalCount.description: Distinct submitted identifiers before the batch cap.

truncated.description: Whether the count or response budget deferred identifiers.
